questions.question: If f(x) = (x - 1)/(x + 2) and g(x) = x + 1, find (f ∘ g)(x).
Find the inverse of f(x) = 2x - 3.
questions.explanation: Set y = 2x - 3. Swap: x = 2y - 3. Solve for y: 2y = x + 3 ⇒ y = (x + 3)/2. So f⁻¹(x) = (x + 3)/2.
questions.fastStrategy: Inverse: swap x and y, solve for y.
